claims.quote: The message of a goal that cannot run says so when it holds such a call: `["in", ["?a", "?b"], ["quote", [[1, 2], [3, 4]]]]` is refused with `["?a","?b"] calls "?a", since an array is always a call. To match a list, write ["array/make","?a","?b"].`
Of 18 failed tries, 10 in 4 tasks write a list pattern as a bare array, which Lion reads as a call.
